newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSE: HOIU GAINS IN ACTIVE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSE: HOIU GAINS IN ACTIVE TRADE.

text.p: * Bourse closes around 1130 or 2.5 hours before usual
* Preliminary closing data show bourse turnover at 46
million kroons compared to Wednesday's 184.3 million kroons.
* Hoiupank the biggest gainer, adding 8.23 kroons
to close at 199.80 kroons on turnover of 13.76 million kroons.
* Tallinna Pank gains 2.75 kroons to 69.95 kroons
* Hansapank turns over 7.1 million kroons to gain
